description: Prototype gallery concept: Hybrid git spine with controlled branches.
title: Gallery Prototype D | Hybrid Branch Timeline

hero.title: Hybrid
hero.subtitle: Branch Timeline
hero.lead: This is the direct merge of the two directions you liked. A clean backbone tells the main story, while selected nodes open into compact sub-branches for thesis, posters, publications, and related work.

aside.title: What You Should Judge Here
aside.copy: Do the sub-branches feel readable instead of noisy? The goal is to show depth node by node without turning the page into a wall of images or cards.

legend.label: Next depth
legend.note: Later can open a full page

nodes.title: School
nodes.copy: Early milestones stay concise so the backbone stays easy to scan.

nodes.title: College
nodes.copy: A transition chapter with room for one anchor image, but still not overloaded with sub-content.

nodes.title: IISER
nodes.copy: This node opens only a few controlled sub-branches. It shows depth, but the page still reads as one main story.

subcards.title: MS Thesis
subcards.copy: Compact item that later links to thesis PDF, abstract, or a detailed thesis page.

subcards.title: Key Project
subcards.copy: A second controlled branch item instead of exposing many separate cards on the root view.

nodes.title: PhD
nodes.copy: The PhD node can be the deepest one, but grouped into branches for posters, publications, and ongoing work so it remains scannable.

subcards.title: Poster Presentations
subcards.copy: One grouped branch item can later open a poster archive instead of listing every poster directly here.

subcards.title: Publications
subcards.copy: A publication branch can point to papers, abstracts, and links without cluttering the main spine.

subcards.title: Current Work
subcards.copy: The last branch item can summarize active themes, ongoing research directions, or current experiments.

sidepanel.title: Reading Model
sidepanel.copy: This page has three depth levels. That is the core mechanism for keeping the story rich without overwhelming users.

rules.title: Level 1
rules.note: Main spine only: School, College, IISER, PhD.

rules.title: Level 2
rules.note: Selected chapters reveal compact sub-branches like MS Thesis, Posters, and Publications.

rules.title: Level 3
rules.note: Each branch item can later open its own detail page or container.

rules.title: Image Strategy
rules.note: One anchor image for a major chapter. Small thumbnails for sub-items. Avoid large images everywhere.

footer: if this direction feels right, the next step should be an interactive version where only one branch is open at a time.
